title: Access
subtitle: Who can open {{family}}, and what they can do.

roles.title: Three roles
roles.SUPER_ADMIN: Manages the account and is the only one who can add or remove Family Admins.
roles.ADMIN: Edits this family: people, relationships, businesses and photos. Can invite Viewers.
roles.VIEWER: Read-only: the tree, member details and business contacts. Personal phone and email stay hidden.

removeConfirmBody: They will no longer be able to open this family. Their account and the family's data are not changed.

dialog.title: Invite someone
dialog.body: They get access to {{family}} the next time they sign in.
dialog.name: Full name
dialog.onlySuperAdmin: Only a Super Admin can add Family Admins.
